title: Metamodel-Guided LLM Decoding for Consistent DSL Generation
title_zh: 元模型引导的LLM解码以实现一致的DSL生成

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate software engineering artifacts written in domain-specific languages (DSLs). Correct DSL instances usually must comply with not only the concrete syntax but also the abstract syntax defined by a metamodel augmented with semantic well-formedness constraints. Existing constrained decoding approaches typically guarantee compliance only with concrete syntax or with a limited set of semantic constraints expressed over the generated text, making metamodel-level constraint consistency difficult to enforce during generation. We present MeMoDecode : a decoding framework that enforces a DSL’s concrete syntax, abstract syntax, and well-formedness constraints jointly. Specifically, whenever the LLM generates a complete metamodel concept, MeMoDecode incrementally maps the current output to a partial model and verifies whether it can still be completed into a consistent instance. We combine MeMoDecode with a simple retry mechanism that resumes decoding from the most recent completable snapshot whenever an inconsistency is detected. Under a sound backend verifier, MeMoDecode never performs worse than grammar-constrained decoding on alignment metrics satisfying natural assumptions. Across four DSLs and six open-weight LLMs ranging from 0.6B to 70B parameters, MeMoDecode achieves the highest consistency, improving consistency by 23% on average over unconstrained decoding and by 8% on average over grammar-constrained decoding. It also improves benchmark performance while incurring only modest runtime overhead. These results show that metamodel-guided decoding is an effective approach for enforcing DSL consistency during decoding across diverse DSLs and LLM scales.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）正被越来越多地用于生成以领域特定语言（DSL）编写的软件工程制品。 正确的 DSL 实例通常不仅要符合具体语法，还要符合由元模型定义、并辅以语义良构性约束的抽象语法。 现有的受限解码方法通常只能保证符合具体语法，或只能保证符合作用于所生成文本的有限语义约束集合，使得在生成过程中难以强制实现元模型层面的约束一致性。 我们提出了 MeMoDecode：一个联合强制 DSL 的具体语法、抽象语法和良构性约束的解码框架。 具体而言，每当 LLM 生成一个完整的元模型概念时，MeMoDecode 便将当前输出增量地映射为一个部分模型，并验证其是否仍能被补全为一致的实例。 我们将 MeMoDecode 与一种简单的重试机制相结合，一旦检测到不一致，就从最近一个可补全的快照恢复解码。 在可靠的后端验证器下，MeMoDecode 在满足自然假设的对齐指标上绝不会比语法受限解码表现更差。 在四个 DSL 和六个参数量从 0.6B 到 70B 的开放权重 LLM 上，MeMoDecode 取得了最高的一致性，相比无约束解码平均提升 23%，相比语法受限解码平均提升 8%。 它还在仅带来适中运行时开销的情况下提升了基准测试性能。 这些结果表明，元模型引导的解码是在解码过程中、跨不同 DSL 和 LLM 规模强制 DSL 一致性的有效方法。

paragraphs.en: Context. Modern software engineering (SE) relies on a wide range of artifacts, from architecture design and configuration to query languages and flowcharts, many of which are expressed in domain-specific languages (DSLs) tailored to a particular task or domain [ 1 ] . As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to automate SE activities, a growing portion of these artifacts is generated, either fully or partially, by LLMs, from natural language specifications [ 2 , 3 ] . Beyond traditional SE workflows, DSL artifacts also serve as structured interfaces in LLM-based agentic systems, supporting multi-agent communication [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] and tool use [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 背景。 现代软件工程（SE）依赖于各种各样的人工制品，从架构设计、配置到查询语言和流程图，其中许多都是用针对特定任务或领域量身定制的领域特定语言（DSL）来表达的 [ 1 ] 。 随着大语言模型（LLM）被越来越多地用于自动化软件工程活动，这些人工制品中越来越多的部分由 LLM 从自然语言规格说明中全部或部分地生成 [ 2 , 3 ] 。 在传统的软件工程工作流程之外，DSL 人工制品还在基于 LLM 的智能体系统中充当结构化接口，支持多智能体通信 [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] 和工具使用 [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] 。

paragraphs.en: In SE, especially in model-driven engineering, DSL instances are often used as machine-processable artifacts for downstream automation, analysis, model transformation, and code generation [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] . As a result, a DSL is typically characterized by three complementary aspects: its concrete syntax , usually defined by a grammar; its abstract syntax , captured by a metamodel; and a set of semantic well-formedness constraints over that metamodel, with execution semantics defined on top of them [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] . These aspects form a hierarchy of correctness. A generated instance may satisfy the grammar while still violating the metamodel or its constraints, preventing meaningful analysis, transformation, or execution. A DSL instance is consistent if it conforms to both the metamodel and the well-formedness constraints [ 16 ] . However, LLMs provide no guarantee that generated DSL instances satisfy these specifications. They may produce outputs that violate the grammar, the metamodel, or the well-formedness constraints, motivating the need for verification techniques [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在软件工程（SE）中，尤其是在模型驱动工程中，DSL 实例常被用作可机器处理的制品，用于下游的自动化、分析、模型转换和代码生成 [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] 。 因此，一个 DSL 通常由三个互补的方面来刻画：其具体语法，通常由文法定义；其抽象语法，由元模型刻画；以及在该元模型上的一组语义良构性约束，执行语义则在这些约束之上定义 [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] 。 这些方面构成了一个正确性层次结构。 一个生成的实例可能满足文法，却仍然违反元模型或其约束，从而无法进行有意义的分析、转换或执行。 如果一个 DSL 实例同时符合元模型和良构性约束，那么它就是一致的 [ 16 ] 。 然而，LLM 无法保证生成的 DSL 实例满足这些规约。 它们可能产生违反文法、元模型或良构性约束的输出，这就促使人们需要验证技术 [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] 。

paragraphs.en: A natural way to improve the reliability of generated DSL instances is post-hoc verification , where a complete instance is first generated and then checked or repaired [ 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 ] . However, these approaches discover violations only after a full generation. As a result, they may waste substantial decoding effort and require additional repair steps. Moreover, as LLM generation is conditioned on existing prefixes, when the generated instance contains early structural errors, subsequent parts of the output are generated from an already invalid context, potentially hurting the overall quality [ 24 , 25 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 提升生成的 DSL 实例可靠性的一种自然方式是事后验证，即先生成一个完整的实例，然后进行检查或修复 [ 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 ] 。 然而，这些方法只有在完成完整生成之后才能发现违规。 因此，它们可能浪费大量的解码计算量，并需要额外的修复步骤。 此外，由于大语言模型的生成以已有前缀为条件，当生成的实例包含早期结构错误时，输出的后续部分将基于一个已经无效的上下文生成，可能损害整体质量 [ 24 , 25 ] 。

paragraphs.en: These limitations motivate decoding-time approaches that prevent invalid outputs before they are completed. Grammar-constrained decoding masks, at each decoding step, tokens that would violate the grammar, thereby guaranteeing syntactic validity [ 26 , 27 , 28 , 29 , 30 , 31 ] . However, operating only on concrete syntax, it provides no guarantee that the generated DSL instance conforms to the metamodel or the associated constraints.

paragraphs.en: Recent approaches further incorporate semantic constraint verification into the decoding process [ 32 , 33 , 34 ] . For example, IterGen [ 35 ] augments grammar-constrained decoding with semantic checks. However, these checks are typically expressed over the generated text rather than the underlying structured model. Consequently, verification remains tied to a particular textual representation. More importantly, it limits the ability to reason about properties that are naturally defined over objects and references in the metamodel, such as multiplicity constraints, referential integrity, and transitive relationships. As a result, decoding-time verification and guidance of metamodel-level constraint consistency over the underlying structured representation remain underexplored [ 19 ] .

paragraphs.en: Approach. In this paper, we present MeMoDecode ( Me ta Mo del-guided Decod ing), a decoding framework that simultaneously enforces a DSL’s concrete syntax, abstract syntax, and semantic well-formedness constraints. The key idea is to lift verification from the generated text to the underlying model representation. As decoding proceeds, MeMoDecode incrementally maps the generated text to a partial model and, whenever the LLM completes a metamodel concept, verifies whether that partial model remains satisfiable with respect to the metamodel and its well-formedness constraints, that is, whether it can still be completed into a consistent instance. If not, the violation is irreparable, and MeMoDecode can immediately backtrack and retry during decoding rather than relying on post-hoc regeneration of the entire output.
paragraphs.zh: 方法。 在本文中，我们提出了 MeMoDecode（MetaModel-guided Decoding，元模型引导的解码），这是一种解码框架，能够同时强制满足具体语法的 DSL、抽象语法以及语义良构性约束。 其核心思想是将验证从生成的文本提升到底层的模型表示。 随着解码的进行，MeMoDecode 增量地将生成的文本映射到一个部分模型，并且每当大语言模型完成一个元模型概念时，就验证该部分模型相对于元模型及其良构性约束是否仍然可满足，也就是说，它是否仍能被补全为一个一致的实例。 如果不可满足，则该违规是不可修复的，MeMoDecode 可以在解码过程中立即回溯并重试，而不是依赖事后重新生成整个输出。

Furthermore, since constraints are specified directly over the metamodel, the verification process is independent of the concrete syntax of the DSL and can be applied across different textual representations. sents.en: More specifically, this paper makes the following contributions:

paragraphs.en: We present MeMoDecode , a decoding framework that simultaneously enforces a DSL’s concrete syntax, abstract syntax, and semantic well-formedness constraints by verifying whether partially generated outputs can still be completed into consistent instances and retrying otherwise.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 MeMoDecode，一种解码框架，它通过验证部分生成的输出是否仍可补全为一致的实例来同时强制满足 DSL 的具体语法、抽象语法和语义良构性约束，否则进行重试。

paragraphs.en: We establish a worst-case guarantee: under a sound verifier and natural assumptions on the alignment metric, MeMoDecode never produces an output that is less aligned than the one generated by grammar-constrained decoding under identical decoding conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们建立了一个最坏情况保证：在校验器可靠且对对齐度量满足自然假设的条件下，MeMoDecode 产出的结果在相同解码条件下绝不会比语法约束解码所生成的结果对齐度更低。

paragraphs.en: We implement MeMoDecode by combining grammar-constrained decoding [ 27 ] with the Refinery verifier [ 36 ] and a lightweight decoding-time retry mechanism.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过将语法约束解码 [27] 与 Refinery 验证器 [36] 以及一种轻量级的解码时重试机制相结合，实现了 MeMoDecode。

paragraphs.en: We conduct a systematic evaluation across four DSLs and six open-weight LLMs ranging from 0.6B to 70B parameters. The results show that MeMoDecode consistently improves DSL consistency, increases alignment with the ground truth, and incurs only modest runtime overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在四种 DSL 和六个参数规模从 0.6B 到 70B 的开放权重 LLM 上进行了系统性评估。 结果表明，MeMoDecode 持续提升 DSL 一致性，增强与真值的对齐，且仅带来适度的运行时开销。

paragraphs.en: Added value. MeMoDecode demonstrates that reasoning over the underlying model representation is key to ensuring consistency of a DSL instance. By lifting verification to the metamodel level, it enables the use of established partial modeling and constraint-solving techniques within the decoding process, yielding consistency guarantees independent of the textual representation. Since verification is decoupled from the underlying LLM, MeMoDecode can benefit directly from future advances in both LLMs and backend verifiers.

paragraphs.en: A domain-specific language (DSL) is tailored to express the concepts of a particular application domain [ 1 ] . By focusing on a specific domain, DSLs can provide substantially higher ease of use than general-purpose programming languages for the tasks they are designed to support [ 11 ] . For instance, Figure 1 shows a CLEVR program specified using a DSL. A CLEVR program is a structured, machine-executable representation of a natural-language question about an image [ 37 ] . The listing illustrates a minimal program to answer the question “What color is the cube?” . The program begins with a scene node that returns the full set of objects in the scene, which is then passed to filter_shape to retain only cube-shaped objects. The unique function asserts that exactly one such object exists, promoting the set of objects to a single object. Finally, query_color is applied to retrieve the color of that object.

paragraphs.en: In SE, and especially in model-driven engineering, a DSL is characterized by three aspects: a concrete syntax, an abstract syntax, and a set of semantic well-formedness constraints [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] (see Figure 2 ). Formally, a DSL specification can be defined as 𝒟 = ( G , M , 𝒞 ) , \mathcal{D}=(G,M,\mathcal{C}), where G G is a context-free grammar (CFG) defining the concrete syntax, M M is a metamodel defining the abstract syntax, and 𝒞 \mathcal{C} is a set of semantic well-formedness constraints over M M .
paragraphs.zh: 在软件工程（SE）中，尤其是在模型驱动工程中，DSL 由三个方面来刻画：具体语法、抽象语法，以及一组语义良构性约束 [13, 14, 15]（见图 2）。 形式上，一个 DSL 规范可以定义为 𝒟 = ( G , M , 𝒞 ) , \mathcal{D}=(G,M,\mathcal{C}), 其中 G G 是定义具体语法的上下文无关文法（CFG），M M 是定义抽象语法的元模型，而 𝒞 \mathcal{C} 是作用于 M M 之上的一组语义良构性约束。

paragraphs.en: Partial models represent incomplete instances of a metamodel [ 42 ] . Instead of fully specifying all elements, a partial model records what is currently known and leaves the remaining information unspecified [ 16 , 43 , 39 ] . Following prior work, we view a partial model as an interpretation of metamodel-level facts , represented as predicates whose truth values may be known, unknown, or inconsistent. In the CLEVR DSL, a partial model may already contain facts such as Node ​ ( n 1 ) \textsc{Node}(n_{1}) , Node ​ ( n 2 ) \textsc{Node}(n_{2}) , Edge ​ ( e 1 ) \textsc{Edge}(e_{1}) , source ​ ( e 1 , n 1 ) \textsc{source}(e_{1},n_{1}) , and target ​ ( e 1 , n 2 ) \textsc{target}(e_{1},n_{2}) , while other facts, such as the node type of n 2 n_{2} or the remaining outgoing edges of n 1 n_{1} , remain unknown. A complete instance model can be obtained by refining the partial model, i.e., by adding new facts until the objects, references, and attribute values are fully determined.

paragraphs.en: LLMs are deep neural networks that typically follow the decoder-only Transformer architecture [ 44 ] . They are trained on massive collections of textual data using the language modeling task , which consists of predicting the next token given a sequence of preceding tokens. In practice, the generation follows an autoregressive process: an LLM receives as input a prompt 𝒙 \boldsymbol{x} and produces a probability distribution over all tokens in its vocabulary, LLM ( 𝐱 ) = P ( ⋅ | 𝒙 ) \mathrm{LLM(\boldsymbol{x})}=P(\cdot|\boldsymbol{x}) . Based on this distribution and a chosen decoding strategy , the next token t ∼ P ( ⋅ | 𝒙 ) t\sim P(\cdot|\boldsymbol{x}) is selected by a sampler and appended to the prompt. The updated sequence is fed back into the LLM, and the process repeats until a predefined termination condition is reached, such as generating an end-of-sequence token, to create an output sequence 𝒚 \boldsymbol{y} .
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）是深度神经网络，通常采用仅解码器（decoder-only）的 Transformer 架构 [ 44 ]。 它们在海量文本数据集合上通过语言建模任务进行训练，该任务是根据给定的前序 token 序列预测下一个 token。 在实践中，生成过程遵循自回归流程：大语言模型接收一个提示 𝒥 作为输入，并在其词表中的所有 token 上产生一个概率分布，LLM ( 𝐱 ) = P ( ⋅ | 𝒙 ) \mathrm{LLM(\boldsymbol{x})}=P(\cdot|\boldsymbol{x}) 。 基于该分布和所选的解码策略，由采样器选出下一个 token t ∼ P ( ⋅ | 𝒙 ) t\sim P(\cdot|\boldsymbol{x}) 并将其附加到提示之后。 更新后的序列被反馈回大语言模型，该过程不断重复，直到满足预定义的终止条件（例如生成序列结束 token），从而产生输出序列 𝒚 \boldsymbol{y} 。

paragraphs.en: Unconstrained decoding strategies select tokens from the probability distribution produced by the LLM directly, without considering DSL-specific validity constraints. For example, temperature sampling adjusts the sharpness of this distribution by scaling the next-token logits before normalization. Other commonly used strategies include greedy decoding, beam search [ 45 ] , top- k k sampling [ 46 ] , and top- p p sampling [ 47 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 无约束解码策略直接从大语言模型产生的概率分布中选择词元，而不考虑特定于 DSL 的有效性约束。 例如，温度采样通过在归一化之前对下一词元的 logits 进行缩放，来调整该分布的锐度。 其他常用的策略包括贪婪解码、束搜索 [ 45 ] 、top- k k 采样 [ 46 ] 和 top- p p 采样 [ 47 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Constrained decoding. In many applications, the generated sequence is required to satisfy constraints beyond those captured by the language model distribution. Constrained decoding refers to decoding methods that restrict token selection using an external constraint specification. Given a set of constraints Φ = { ϕ 1 , … , ϕ k } \Phi=\{\phi_{1},\ldots,\phi_{k}\} , the goal is to generate an output sequence 𝒚 \boldsymbol{y} such that 𝒚 \boldsymbol{y} satisfies every constraint in Φ \Phi , while still using the LLM probabilities to guide token selection.
paragraphs.zh: 受约束解码。 在许多应用中，生成的序列需要满足超出语言模型分布所刻画的约束。 受约束解码是指利用外部约束规范来限制词元选择的解码方法。 给定一组约束 Φ = { ϕ 1 , … , ϕ k } \Phi=\{\phi_{1},\ldots,\phi_{k}\} ，目标是生成输出序列 𝒚 \boldsymbol{y} ，使得 𝒚 \boldsymbol{y} 满足 Φ \Phi 中的每一个约束，同时仍然利用大语言模型的概率来指导词元选择。

paragraphs.en: When the constraint specification is a CFG G G , the constraint is that the final output must belong to the language generated by the grammar, i.e., 𝒚 ∈ L ⁡ ( G ) \boldsymbol{y}\in L(G) . Such methods are commonly referred to as grammar-constrained decoding [ 26 , 27 , 28 , 29 , 30 , 31 ] . The core idea is to maintain a parser state induced by the output and, at each decoding step, mask tokens that would make the output impossible to extend into a syntactically valid sequence [ 26 , 28 ] . As a result, these approaches enforce concrete-syntax validity during generation, but do not by themselves ensure that the resulting instance model is consistent.
paragraphs.zh: 当约束规范是一个 CFG G G 时，约束为最终输出必须属于该文法生成的语言，即 𝒚 ∈ L ⁡ ( G ) \boldsymbol{y}\in L(G)。 这类方法通常被称为文法约束解码 [ 26 , 27 , 28 , 29 , 30 , 31 ]。 其核心思想是维护一个由输出导出的解析器状态，并在每个解码步骤中屏蔽那些会使输出无法扩展为句法有效序列的词元 [ 26 , 28 ]。 因此，这些方法在生成过程中保证了具体语法层面的有效性，但其本身并不能确保所得的实例模型是一致的。

paragraphs.en: Beyond grammar-constrained decoding. Several approaches augment grammar-constrained decoding with additional semantic reasoning mechanisms. These approaches typically refine the token mask by incorporating complementary information, such as semantic pruners or static analyzers, thereby restricting generation with additional constraints [ 32 , 33 , 34 ] . However, they either lack sufficient expressive power to capture complex structured semantic properties [ 32 ] or focus on a narrow class of constraints [ 34 , 33 ] . For example, ChopChop [ 32 ] employs semantic pruners. Given a program space, a semantic pruner returns the subspace of programs that satisfy a particular constraint, such as type consistency. Such pruners cannot fully express all types of constraints. Other approaches [ 33 , 34 , 48 ] focus only on specific language semantic properties rather than general DSL specifications.
paragraphs.zh: 超越语法约束解码。 若干方法在语法约束解码的基础上增加了额外的语义推理机制。 这些方法通常通过融入补充信息来细化token掩码，例如语义剪枝器或静态分析器，从而以额外的约束限制生成 [ 32 , 33 , 34 ] 。 然而，它们要么缺乏足够的表达能力来捕捉复杂的结构化语义属性 [ 32 ] ，要么仅关注范围狭窄的一类约束 [ 34 , 33 ] 。 例如，ChopChop [ 32 ] 采用了语义剪枝器。 给定一个程序空间，语义剪枝器返回满足特定约束（例如类型一致性）的程序子空间。 这类剪枝器无法完全表达所有类型的约束。 其他方法 [ 33 , 34 , 48 ] 仅关注特定的语言语义属性，而非通用的DSL规范。

paragraphs.en: IterGen [ 35 ] takes a different approach by building on SynCode [ 29 ] with an iterative backtracking mechanism that revises previously generated tokens upon constraint violations. It introduces three operations: forward (generate until a syntactic unit is reached), backward (rewind to a previously generated syntactic unit), and view (retrieve the strings associated with a syntactic unit), enabling programmatic inspection and enforcement of semantic constraints during decoding.
paragraphs.zh: IterGen[35]采用了不同的方法，它在SynCode[29]的基础上构建了一种迭代回溯机制，当违反约束时会修订先前生成的词元。 它引入了三种操作：前进（生成直到到达一个句法单元）、后退（回退到先前生成的句法单元）和查看（检索与某个句法单元关联的字符串），从而在解码过程中实现以编程方式检查和强制执行语义约束。

This conflates concrete and abstract syntax, tying constraints to surface details such as delimiters, keywords, and whitespace rather than to the underlying objects, attributes, and references. Users need to re-implement parsing and structural analysis that a proper abstract syntax representation provides directly, making constraints harder to maintain and reason about as the DSL evolves.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，IterGen 在具体语法层面暴露中间片段。 特别是，view 返回原始字符串，因此约束检查必须通过字符串处理或模式匹配来实现。 这混淆了具体语法和抽象语法，使约束依赖于分隔符、关键字和空白等表层细节，而不是依赖于底层的对象、属性和引用。 用户需要重新实现本应由恰当的抽象语法表示直接提供的解析和结构分析，这使得随着 DSL 的演化，约束变得更难维护和推理。

paragraphs.en: LLMs are increasingly used to automate the creation of software artifacts, many of which are expressed in DSLs [ 2 , 3 ] . Early work has primarily used unconstrained decoding to study the ability of LLMs to generate DSL instances, including software models [ 49 , 50 , 51 ] and executable queries [ 52 , 53 ] . More recent approaches introduce explicit checking mechanisms, either during decoding through grammar-constrained generation [ 54 , 17 ] , or after generation through post-hoc verification and repair [ 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 ] . These techniques improve the validity of generated DSL instances, but they either focus mainly on concrete syntax or check validity only after a complete artifact is produced.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于自动创建软件制品，其中许多制品以领域特定语言（DSL）表示 [ 2 , 3 ] 。 早期工作主要使用无约束解码来研究大语言模型生成 DSL 实例的能力，包括软件模型 [ 49 , 50 , 51 ] 和可执行查询 [ 52 , 53 ] 。 较新的方法引入了显式检查机制，或者在解码期间通过语法约束生成实现 [ 54 , 17 ] ，或者在生成之后通过事后验证与修复实现 [ 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 ] 。 这些技术提高了所生成 DSL 实例的有效性，但它们要么主要关注具体语法，要么只在完整制品生成之后才检查有效性。

paragraphs.en: Existing work typically evaluates the generated artifact with a reference artifact or its expected execution result. We refer to such a measure as an alignment score s ⁡ ( 𝒚 ) s(\boldsymbol{y}) , which quantifies how well a generated output 𝒚 \boldsymbol{y} aligns with the intended output. Depending on the DSL, s s can be instantiated as a structural similarity metric, such as an F1 score over generated elements, or as an execution-based metric, such as result accuracy.

paragraphs.en: MeMoDecode complements existing LLM-based DSL generation approaches by augmenting LLM decoding with metamodel-level verification. Unlike unconstrained approaches, which may introduce syntactic or semantic violations during generation, and post-hoc repair approaches, which detect such violations only after a complete artifact has been produced, MeMoDecode rejects inconsistent structural decisions before they become part of the accepted generation context. Compared with constrained generation approaches, MeMoDecode is closest to IterGen, but lifts the corresponding checks from concrete-syntax fragments to the metamodel level. As a result, MeMoDecode performs semantic pruning during decoding while keeping verification independent of a particular textual representation.
paragraphs.zh: MeMoDecode 通过在 LLM 解码中加入元模型层面的验证，对现有的基于 LLM 的 DSL 生成方法进行了补充。 无约束方法可能在生成过程中引入语法或语义违规，事后修复方法则只有在完整制品生成之后才能检测到此类违规；与之不同，MeMoDecode 会在不一致的结构性决策成为已接受生成上下文的一部分之前就将其拒绝。 与受约束生成方法相比，MeMoDecode 与 IterGen 最为接近，但它把相应的检查从具体语法片段提升到了元模型层面。 因此，MeMoDecode 在解码过程中执行语义剪枝，同时使验证独立于特定的文本表示。

By enforcing these consistency properties during decoding, MeMoDecode also aims to improve the alignment score s ⁡ ( 𝒚 ) s(\boldsymbol{y}) as a secondary effect.

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 summarizes the MeMoDecode framework. Decoding begins by initializing the artifacts maintained by MeMoDecode : an empty generated token sequence, a syntactic parser in its initial grammar state, and an empty partial model. MeMoDecode maintains these artifacts during generation. During decoding, a grammar-constrained decoding approach ensures token-level conformance to the concrete syntax. The generated tokens are then appended to the sequence and consumed by the syntactic unit extraction module. Whenever a completed syntactic unit is generated, the syntax to partial model mapping maps this unit to metamodel-level facts over M M . These facts are tentatively added to a partial model, and a backend semantic verifier checks whether the partial model remains completable with respect to ( M , 𝒞 ) (M,\mathcal{C}) . The artifacts are updated with the unit only if this check succeeds; otherwise, it is rejected and the decoding retries. This process continues until the termination condition is reached.
paragraphs.zh: 图 3 总结了 MeMoDecode 框架。 解码首先初始化 MeMoDecode 维护的各构件：一个空的已生成 token 序列、一个处于初始文法状态的句法解析器，以及一个空的部分模型。 MeMoDecode 在生成过程中维护这些构件。 在解码过程中，一种文法约束的解码方法确保 token 层面符合具体语法。 生成的 token 随后被追加到序列中，并由句法单元提取模块消费。 每当生成一个完整的句法单元，语法到部分模型的映射就在 M M 上将该单元映射为元模型层面的事实。 这些事实被暂时添加到部分模型中，后端语义验证器检查该部分模型相对于 (M,\mathcal{C}) 是否仍然可完成。 只有当该检查成功时，构件才会用该单元进行更新；否则该单元被拒绝，解码进行重试。 这一过程持续进行，直到达到终止条件。

paragraphs.en: As tokens are generated, the syntactic unit extraction module uses an incremental parser to detect when the output completes a selected syntactic unit. These non-terminals are DSL-specific and are configured by the language engineer. Whenever such a unit is completed, the parser extracts the corresponding grammar fragment and passes it to the mapping module. For example, the highlighted text fragments in Figure 4 .b, c, and d correspond to information such as node and edge declarations.

paragraphs.en: We formalize this check using the notion of refinement. A refinement operation adds information to a partial model by resolving previously unknown facts, such as introducing missing objects, assigning attribute values, or creating references. We write P ⊑ I P\sqsubseteq I when a complete instance model I I refines a partial model P P , i.e., when I I preserves all facts already fixed in P P and resolves the remaining unknowns. A partial model P P is completable with respect to ( M , 𝒞 ) (M,\mathcal{C}) if there exists at least one complete consistent refinement: ∃ I ​ P ⊑ I ∧ I ⊧ ( M , C ) \exists I\>P\sqsubseteq I\land I\models(M,C) . Accordingly, a violation is unfixable if the newly added facts make the candidate partial model not completable. In that case, no continuation of the current prefix can produce a consistent instance without revising previously accepted decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用精化这一概念来形式化这项检查。 精化操作通过解决先前未知的事实，为部分模型添加信息，例如引入缺失的对象、赋属性值或创建引用。 当完整实例模型 I 精化部分模型 P 时，我们记作 P ⊑ I，即当 I 保留 P 中已固定的所有事实并解决其余未知项时。 若至少存在一个完整的、一致的精化：∃ I P ⊑ I ∧ I ⊧ (M, C)，则部分模型 P 关于 (M, 𝒞) 是可补全的。 相应地，如果新添加的事实导致候选部分模型不可补全，则该违规是不可修复的。 在这种情况下，若不修改先前已接受的决策，当前前缀的任何延续都无法产生一致的实例。

paragraphs.en: MeMoDecode uses Refinery as a sound backend verifier [ 36 ] to determine whether the current partial model is completable. If the candidate partial model P ′ P^{\prime} is completable, MeMoDecode commits the syntactic unit u u , updates the accepted partial model to P ′ P^{\prime} , and stores a snapshot of the current decoding state. This snapshot includes the accepted tokens, the parser state, and the partial model, so that decoding can later resume from this point if needed.

Decoding continues from the most recent completable snapshot using temperature sampling. Since the sampling is stochastic, the regenerated sequence may create a different syntactic unit. This retry strategy is intentionally lightweight, allowing us to focus mainly on the effect of metamodel-level verification.

paragraphs.en: The decoding process terminates when either the LLM produces an end-of-sequence token or the parser state indicates no further tokens are required to complete the DSL instance. As a safeguard against non-termination, decoding also stops once the output reaches a maximum number of tokens. Finally, if semantic verification repeatedly rejects candidates and the retry budget is exhausted, MeMoDecode falls back to using only the grammar-guided decoding module from the most recent completable snapshot. This fallback ensures that decoding can still terminate with a syntactically valid output when the lightweight retry strategy cannot find a completable continuation within the budget.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the impact of MeMoDecode on syntactic validity, consistency, token efficiency, alignment, and runtime. Specifically, we investigate the following research questions:
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估 MeMoDecode 对句法有效性、一致性、token 效率、对齐性和运行时间的影响。 具体而言，我们研究以下研究问题：

sents.en: We evaluate the impact of MeMoDecode on syntactic validity, consistency, token efficiency, alignment, and runtime.
sents.zh: 我们评估 MeMoDecode 对句法有效性、一致性、token 效率、对齐性和运行时间的影响。

sents.en: Specifically, we investigate the following research questions:
sents.zh: 具体而言，我们研究以下研究问题：

paragraphs.en: RQ1 : How does MeMoDecode influence the syntactic validity and consistency of generated DSL instances with respect to the metamodel and well-formedness constraints?
paragraphs.zh: RQ1：MeMoDecode 如何影响所生成 DSL 实例在元模型和良构性约束方面的语法有效性与一致性？

paragraphs.en: RQ2 : How token-efficient is MeMoDecode in producing consistent instances compared with grammar-guided and unconstrained decoding under post-hoc verification?
paragraphs.zh: RQ2：与语法引导解码和无约束解码在后验验证下相比，MeMoDecode 在生成一致实例时的 token 效率如何？

paragraphs.en: RQ3 : How does MeMoDecode affect the alignment scores of the generated instances?
paragraphs.zh: RQ3：MeMoDecode 如何影响所生成实例的对齐分数？

paragraphs.en: RQ4 : What runtime overhead does MeMoDecode introduce compared with other decoding components?
paragraphs.zh: RQ4：与其他解码组件相比，MeMoDecode 引入了多少运行时开销？

paragraphs.en: The experiments are conducted on four popular DSL generation benchmarks grouped into two categories, as summarized in Table I . The first category consists of non-executable DSLs , which represent structured artifacts such as graph models without execution semantics. In SE, these DSLs are commonly used to describe system architectures, configurations, and taxonomies.

paragraphs.en: We compare MeMoDecode with two baseline decoding approaches. To control potential variability, we use the same LLM, prompt, sampler, and random seed, differing only in the constraints enforced during decoding.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 MeMoDecode 与两种基线解码方法进行比较。 为了控制潜在的变异性，我们使用相同的大语言模型、提示词、采样器和随机种子，仅在解码过程中执行的约束上有所不同。

sents.en: We compare MeMoDecode with two baseline decoding approaches.
sents.zh: 我们将 MeMoDecode 与两种基线解码方法进行比较。

sents.en: To control potential variability, we use the same LLM, prompt, sampler, and random seed, differing only in the constraints enforced during decoding.
sents.zh: 为了控制潜在的变异性，我们使用相同的大语言模型、提示词、采样器和随机种子，仅在解码过程中执行的约束上有所不同。

paragraphs.en: Unconstrained decoding ( Unc ) performs standard autoregressive sampling without any constraints, measuring how often the LLM produces valid DSL instances by itself.
paragraphs.zh: 无约束解码（Unc）执行标准的自回归采样，不施加任何约束，用于衡量大语言模型自行生成有效 DSL 实例的频率。

paragraphs.en: Grammar-constrained decoding ( Grammar ) masks, at each decoding step, tokens that would violate the DSL context-free grammar. This ensures that the generated output is syntactically valid with respect to the concrete syntax, following prior grammar-constrained decoding approaches [ 26 , 27 , 28 , 29 , 30 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 语法约束解码（Grammar）在每个解码步骤中屏蔽会违反该 DSL 上下文无关文法的词元。 参照已有的语法约束解码方法 [26, 27, 28, 29, 30]，这确保了生成的输出在具体语法层面是句法合法的。

sents.en: This ensures that the generated output is syntactically valid with respect to the concrete syntax, following prior grammar-constrained decoding approaches [ 26 , 27 , 28 , 29 , 30 ] .

paragraphs.en: We evaluate six open-weight, instruction-tuned LLMs from three families: Qwen3 (0.6B, 8B, and 32B parameters) [ 62 ] , Gemma-4 (E2B and 26B) [ 63 ] , and Llama3.3-70B [ 64 ] . These LLMs span different capacities, allowing us to evaluate whether the effects of MeMoDecode are limited to smaller LLMs that frequently generate inconsistent outputs or persist for stronger LLMs that already exhibit high capability. We additionally report GPT-5.5 [ 65 ] under unconstrained decoding as a state-of-the-art reference.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了来自三个系列的六个开放权重、指令微调的大语言模型：Qwen3（0.6B、8B 和 32B 参数）[ 62 ]、Gemma-4（E2B 和 26B）[ 63 ] 以及 Llama3.3-70B [ 64 ]。 这些大语言模型涵盖了不同的能力规模，使我们能够评估 MeMoDecode 的效果是仅限于频繁生成不一致输出的较小模型，还是对已经具备高能力的更强模型依然持续有效。 我们还报告了在无约束解码下 GPT-5.5 [ 65 ] 作为最先进的参考基准。

paragraphs.en: Although MeMoDecode is LLM-agnostic, we evaluate it only on open-weight LLMs because it requires direct access to the decoding process, including next-token logits, token-level masking, and the ability to reject generated tokens. Current proprietary APIs typically expose only sampled outputs or limited constrained decoding interfaces. For example, while the GPT-5.5 API supports constrained decoding, its constraints are limited to JSON schemas and therefore cannot express either grammar-constrained decoding or the partial-model verification performed by MeMoDecode . Consequently, GPT-5.5 is evaluated only under unconstrained decoding.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 MeMoDecode 与大语言模型无关，我们仅在开放权重大语言模型上对其进行评估，因为它需要直接访问解码过程，包括下一个词元的 logits、词元级掩码，以及拒绝已生成词元的能力。 目前的专有 API 通常只提供采样输出或受限的受限解码接口。 例如，虽然 GPT-5.5 API 支持受限解码，但其约束仅限于 JSON 模式，因此既无法表达语法受限解码，也无法执行 MeMoDecode 所进行的部分模型验证。 因此，GPT-5.5 仅在无约束解码下进行评估。

paragraphs.en: For RQ1, we report two metrics that measure the correctness of the generated DSL instances. Syntactic validity ( Syn ) is the fraction of outputs that parse according to the DSL’s concrete syntax. Consistency ( Con ) is the fraction of outputs that are additionally consistent with the metamodel and its well-formedness constraints ( M , 𝒞 ) (M,\mathcal{C}) . Note that every consistent instance must also be syntactically valid.

paragraphs.zh: 原理与设置。 在RQ1中，我们评估生成过程中解码时验证的效果。 具体而言，我们研究与Unc和Grammar基线相比，MeMoDecode如何影响句法有效性以及相对于 ( M , 𝒞 ) (M,\mathcal{C}) 的一致性，以及这些改进是否能在不同的大语言模型系列和规模之间泛化。

paragraphs.en: Results. Table II reports the syntactic validity and consistency of the generated instances. Grammar achieves near-perfect syntactic validity in almost all cases, and MeMoDecode largely preserves this property. The largest reduction is only 2% (92.7% vs. 90.7% for Gemma4-E2B on Taxonomy), while the remaining differences are within 0.5%. In contrast, Unc decoding is substantially less reliable. For example, Gemma4-E2B and Gemma4-26B output almost no syntactically valid Flowcharts (0.0% and 1.1%), showing that smaller LLMs cannot follow the syntactic structure on their own.

paragraphs.en: MeMoDecode achieves the highest consistency for every LLM and benchmark combination, outperforming Grammar throughout. The only exception is Flowchart with Qwen3-32B , where both approaches achieve 97.2%. The improvements are often substantial, especially for smaller LLMs. For example, MeMoDecode increases the consistency of Qwen3-0.6B from 36.0% to 66.7% on Taxonomy (+30.7%) and from 5.6% to 31.2% on CLEVR (+25.6%). paragraphs.en: Rationale and setup. The consistency improvements in RQ1 come at additional token costs since retries are performed during decoding. RQ2 checks if this cost is justified by asking how efficiently, in terms of generated tokens, MeMoDecode produces consistent instances compared to baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 理由与设置。 RQ1 中的一致性提升带来了额外的 token 开销，因为解码过程中会执行重试。 RQ2 检验这一开销是否合理，即从生成 token 数量的角度衡量，MeMoDecode 相比基线方法生成一致实例的效率如何。

sents.zh: 理由与设置。

sents.en: RQ2 checks if this cost is justified by asking how efficiently, in terms of generated tokens, MeMoDecode produces consistent instances compared to baselines.

paragraphs.en: A common alternative to constrained decoding is post-hoc verification [ 21 , 22 ] . In this case, LLMs generate multiple outputs, and the verifier retains only consistent instances. Higher consistency may then be achieved by generating more outputs, making token efficiency the quality of interest.
paragraphs.zh: 约束解码的一种常见替代方法是事后验证 [ 21 , 22 ] 。 在这种情况下，大语言模型生成多个输出，验证器只保留一致的实例。 通过生成更多输出可以获得更高的一致性，这使得 token 效率成为关注的质量指标。

sents.zh: 在这种情况下，大语言模型生成多个输出，验证器只保留一致的实例。

sents.en: Higher consistency may then be achieved by generating more outputs, making token efficiency the quality of interest.
sents.zh: 通过生成更多输出可以获得更高的一致性，这使得 token 效率成为关注的质量指标。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate this trade-off on Qwen3-8B , a representative mid-sized LLM. We use best-of- N N consistency , defined as the fraction of prompts for which at least one of N N sampled instances is consistent. This simulates a post-hoc verifier that always selects a consistent candidate whenever one exists. We reuse the three runs from RQ1 for MeMoDecode and perform additional runs for Unc and Grammar until their average cumulative token count matches that of MeMoDecode , whose token counts include all retries. We record the best-of- N N consistency with the corresponding expected output tokens, yielding a consistency-token trade-off curve for each approach.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 Qwen3-8B（一个具有代表性的中等规模大语言模型）上评估这种权衡。 我们使用 best-of-N 一致性，其定义为在 N 个采样实例中至少有一个实例保持一致的提示所占的比例。 这模拟了一个事后验证器，只要存在一致的候选结果，它就总是选择该一致的候选结果。 我们复用 RQ1 中针对 MeMoDecode 的三次运行，并为 Unc 和 Grammar 执行额外运行，直到其平均累计 token 数与 MeMoDecode 的 token 数（其 token 数包含所有重试）相匹配。 我们记录 best-of-N 一致性及其对应的期望输出 token 数，从而为每种方法得到一条一致性-token 权衡曲线。

paragraphs.en: Results. The best-of- N N consistency against the expected number of output tokens per instance for Qwen3-8B is plotted in Figure 5 . As expected, MeMoDecode generates more output tokens per instance than the baselines. At N = 1 N=1 , its curve starts farthest to the right on every benchmark (e.g., approximately 470 versus 350 tokens on Taxonomy), reflecting the additional retries performed during decoding. Unc and Grammar generate a similar number of tokens because Grammar only applies token masking without introducing retries.

Still, the objective of DSL generation is often to produce instances that correctly capture the intention of the natural language input. Under the assumptions on the alignment scorer, Theorem 1 predicts that MeMoDecode cannot achieve a lower alignment score than Grammar . In this RQ, we evaluate this prediction empirically. We reuse the generation results from RQ1 and evaluate them using the alignment metrics. For the structural DSLs, we report both the standard Soft F1 score and its Hard-0 F1 ∗ variant. For the executable DSLs, we report denotation accuracy for Block and answer accuracy for CLEVR. These metrics instantiate the alignment scorer s s in the theorem.

paragraphs.en: DSL correctness goes beyond syntactic validity. RQ1-RQ3 show that syntactic validity alone is insufficient to ensure correctness of generated DSL instances. Grammar-constrained decoding is effective at enforcing the concrete syntax, but it can still generate inconsistent instances and, in some cases, even achieve lower consistency than unconstrained decoding. By verifying the generated outputs at the metamodel level, MeMoDecode provides an additional layer of correctness beyond syntax. This leads to systematic improvements in consistency and, for alignment metrics that treat invalid instances as unusable, also improves alignment with the intended output.

paragraphs.en: LLM capacity and guarantee. RQ1 and RQ3 show that larger LLMs can improve both consistency and alignment. However, they still fail to produce consistent DSL instances in many cases. paragraphs.en: Runtime overhead and retry. RQ4 shows that the main runtime overhead of MeMoDecode comes from the additional LLM inference introduced by regenerating tokens after rejected syntactic units, while metamodel-level verification accounts for only a small fraction of the total runtime. Therefore, future work should focus on more efficient retry and recovery strategies, such as finer-grained backtracking, adaptive retry budgets, verifier-guided resampling, or decoding-time repair mechanisms that reduce the need for regeneration.

paragraphs.en: Limitations and future work. While MeMoDecode improves over both baseline decoding approaches, several limitations remain for future work. First, this paper focuses on unfixable constraints, while accepting partial models with fixable violations. Future work could explore how to use these fixable violations as decoding-time heuristics. Currently, MeMoDecode focuses only on the final output generated by the LLM. Future work could extend the framework to reasoning LLMs, where verification may guide not only the generated DSL tokens but also intermediate reasoning traces. Finally, MeMoDecode could be integrated with DSL frameworks such as Xtext [ 55 ] and JetBrains MPS [ 67 ] to streamline DSL development with verified LLM-based instance generation.

paragraphs.en: This paper presented MeMoDecode , a metamodel-guided decoding framework for generating consistent DSL instances with LLMs. Unlike other decoding approaches, MeMoDecode lifts verification to the metamodel level by mapping generated text to a partial model and checking whether it remains completable with respect to the metamodel and well-formedness constraints. Under a sound verifier, we showed that MeMoDecode never performs worse than grammar-constrained decoding for alignment metrics satisfying natural assumptions. Across four DSL benchmarks and six open-weight LLMs, MeMoDecode improves consistency and alignment while preserving syntactic validity and introducing only modest runtime overhead. Future work includes reducing runtime through more efficient retry strategies, extending MeMoDecode to fixable constraints and reasoning LLMs, and integrating it with DSL frameworks to streamline adoption.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了 MeMoDecode，一个由元模型引导的解码框架，用于借助大语言模型生成一致的 DSL 实例。 与其他解码方法不同，MeMoDecode 将验证提升到元模型层面，它把生成的文本映射到一个部分模型，并检查该模型在元模型和良构性约束下是否仍可补全。 在验证器可靠的前提下，我们证明了对于满足自然假设的对齐指标，MeMoDecode 的表现从不逊于语法约束解码。 在四个 DSL 基准和六个开放权重大语言模型上的实验表明，MeMoDecode 在提升一致性与对齐度的同时，保持了语法有效性，且仅引入了有限的运行时开销。 未来的工作包括通过更高效的重试策略降低运行时开销，将 MeMoDecode 扩展到可修复约束和推理型大语言模型，并将其与 DSL 框架集成以简化采用流程。
